en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 13.2.
Vedanāttika (The Triplet on Feeling)
Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition:
dependent on the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, pleasant feeling and the mind-originated [matter] arise.
Form; at the moment of rebirth-linking ... [etc. ... (The great primary elements are not present).
Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition:
dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter ... [etc. ... dependent on [aggregates] associated with pleasant feeling.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling,
there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition. Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling,
there arise states associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and associated with unpleasant feeling by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, there arise states that are neither associated with painful feeling nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, [there arise states] that are neither associated with pleasant feeling nor associated with painful feeling... [and so forth].
States arise with root condition. Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling,
there arise states associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and not associated with painful feeling, with root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, a state not associated with painful feeling arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, a state not associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling...
A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, states associated with neither-pleasant-nor-unpleasant feeling and associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling... [and so forth].

Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, states that are neither associated with painful feeling nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling,
states that are neither associated with pleasant feeling nor associated with painful feeling arise by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, there arise states associated neither with pleasant feeling nor with painful feeling nor with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, [there arise states] not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...
A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a state associated with painful feeling arises by way of root condition.

By way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arise states associated with neither-pleasant-nor-unpleasant feeling and states not associated with pleasant feeling, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, [there arises] a state not associated with painful feeling...
And states associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, states associated with neither-pleasant-nor-unpleasant feeling and associated with neither-painful-nor-unpleasant feeling arise by way of root-condition. [Dependent on] a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arise states associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, not associated with pleasant feeling, and not associated with painful feeling, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition: twenty-one;
under object condition: twenty-one … pe … under prenascence and repetition conditions: fourteen … pe … under non-disappearance condition: twenty-one.
Negative:
Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling that is not a cause, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of the non-root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the absence of root-condition, twenty-one; in the absence of object-condition, twenty-one …pe… in the absence of kamma-condition, nine …pe… in the absence of dissociation-condition, fourteen …pe… in the absence of disappearance-condition, twenty-one.
(The sections on co-nascence, condition, support, association, and conjunction are similar to the section on dependence. 13.2.7.
Question Section (Pañhāvāra)
13.2.7.1. Positive Conditionality (Paccayānuloma): Root-condition (Hetu).
A state associated with pleasant feeling is related to a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root-condition.
Condition. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state associated with painful feeling.
A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. A state associated with pleasant feeling...

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition,
by way of root-condition, for a state associated with painful feeling and for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
Condition: A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state associated neither with pleasant feeling nor with painful feeling.

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state associated neither with pleasant feeling nor with painful feeling, nor with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...
And it is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state associated with feeling.
(Abbreviated. Under root there are twenty-one; under object there are twenty-one ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are twenty-one. (The Chapter of Questions should be expanded.)
